title: Register now for our upcoming webinar on oral health and healthy ageing
html:
The CE accredited webinar will take place on 22 January at 3PM CET on the FDI Oral Health Campus. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn about system-based approaches to improving oral health in long-term care settings.

FDI is pleased to announce an upcoming webinar on the FDI Oral Health Campus, titled "Oral Health and Healthy Ageing: Prevention and Integration in Long-Term Care Systems". The webinar will take place on Thursday 22 January 2026 at 3:00PM CET.

This timely and CE-accredited event will explore the critical role of oral health in healthy ageing, with a particular focus on how oral care can be effectively integrated into long-term care systems to improve the quality of life of older adults.

Register here

 

What to expect from the webinar

As populations continue to age, the need for health care approaches that address both oral and general health is becoming increasingly urgent. This webinar will bring together a panel of leading experts in gerontology and dental care to share practical insights on prevention strategies and the integration of oral health services.

Participants can expect to learn about innovative approaches to maintain oral health in elderly populations, the essential role of caregivers in supporting daily oral hygiene, and best practices for collaboration between dental and other health professionals.

Whether you are a dental practitioner or other health professional, or simply interested in oral health and ageing, this webinar offers valuable knowledge and actionable perspectives to support better outcomes for older adults.

Mark your calendars and register today.

 

The Oral Health for an Ageing Population project is supported by GC Corporation and the Nakao Foundation.
